chapters.html:
Phainon noticed it.

Of course he did! 

How could he not when he saw the way Mydei’s movements had turned sluggish, slow, and almost dull. The way he almost seemed uninterested in sparring, much more keen on focusing on other less intense activities. At first Phainon had written it off as him being distracted, but after a few days of Mydei refusing even though Phainon’s light-hearted taunts. He was growing worried..

So, Phainon began noticing all of Mydei’s odd recent mannerisms.

The way Mydei even seemed to slightly slouch a bit to the side while eating, eyes half-lidded as he glared at his food as if it was his fault for whatever was plaguing the crown prince. The way he seemed disinterested in cooking. The way he seemed to barely manage to read a single page of any book before giving up. The way he seemed to be avoiding any children who he usually would indulge in their desires to play with him gently and tenderly. 

After a few days of it - Phainon had enough. The idea of Mydei being assigned to a mission like this was practically eating him alive with worry!

Thus, Phainon now fully had Mydei cornered after offering his favorite food and practically dragging him through Okhema openly. Something that was even more curious as Mydei had not put up much of a fight either with the fashion Phainon had a grasp on his arm as he led him. Even as Phainon waved and greeted the vendors who worked their stalls in the main streets.. 

Usually Mydei at least hissed out some arguments and would thrash out of that hold - Not just allow it to happen silently! A worrying sign..

Phainon could only knit his brows as he sat across the man who had accepted the golden honeycakes, but still remained sitting there just somewhat vacant of any heavy reactions.

“Mydei,” Phainon began, pausing slightly as he propped his head up on his hand using the table to study the way the man barely responded. It was hard to tell when something was plaguing Mydei physically. His body never allowed him to show signs of it. So the only option was that it was something mentally plaguing him. 

But.. What? 

Whatever it was managed to make Phainon worry too! He had fought this man for ten nights and days in a row, seeing him become so obviously distraught and zoned out was beyond worrying!

“Are you well?” Phainon gingerly asked, knitting his brows together as those liquid amber eyes found their way to Phainon. Only to blink once.. Twice… Thrice.. Before looking away again with a deep sigh. 

“Do not dwell on useless things, Deliverer.” Was the stern low spoken reply from Mydei, which was easier to say than to do! By far!

Mydei was a pillar of strength, unwavering and unyielding in how boldly he stood. 

It was only natural for Phainon to feel uneasy and worried with him clearly doing unwell!

Phainon could only lean back at that before giving a light scoff, inspecting Mydei who seemed to refuse to meet his gaze - A rarity. 

Mydei was, to be expected, flawless. There were no blemishes, nothing to give away him being unwell, not a single scratch or mark on him, not even a single lock of hair out of place. 

“Your mental health is far from a ‘useless thing’ to dwell on.” Phainon sighed out dramatically, blue eyes looking at those untouched honeycakes with just a hint of sorrow as he blinked. Hoping his veil of woe wasn’t too painfully obvious - Even though everyone always said his feelings were worn on his sleeve. “Are you going to indulge me in your pressing issues, or must we always fight for you to open up?”

Mydei shuffled a bit slightly, moving to cross his arms and glare daggers at Phainon. Something that may have carried more merit if the man didn’t look like he was two minutes away from toppling over. Mydei seemed to consider those two options a bit heavily, and Phainon was creeping to around a seventy percent chance that Mydei may opt to try to throw him around.

A welcomed event! It had been days since Mydei and Phainon had sparred! 

“It’s not a big and grand issue.” Mydei slowly said instead, uncrossing his arms to instead slowly focus on eating a few small bites of his honeycakes. An action Phainon scrutinized - The way Mydei was tugging off pieces, small and pathetic pieces. Mydei was so blatantly unengaged with actually eating, that Phainon had the crawling feeling that Mydei agreeing to come was a plea for help from the man.

“Yet, it is one that hangs heavy over you.” Phainon countered as he remained watching Mydei take small bites of his food, not even appearing to relish in it. 

Mydei slowly set down his utensil at that, taking a moment to stare at the plate of food before drifting those dangerous looking eyes to Phainon. 

“I have not been finding sleep easily.”

Phainon took his time registering those words, fully comprehending them, trying to search for any hidden meaning. He found none. “.. Sleep?”

Mydei was sleepy?

The crown prince gave a bit of a sigh, seeming more tired by the second that he had to explain himself to Phainon. Which was probably a valid feeling. “While my body is immortal, my mind is not immune to being overworked.” Amber eyes squinted slightly at Phainon, before focusing wholly on the honeycakes again. “So, yes. I am having some slight.. Issues with functioning at full capacity due to my lack of sleep.”

“Huh..” Phainon slowly muttered out, he certainly hadn’t expected that. Not with their past records of staying awake for days without sleep in fights - But perhaps that was equal adrenaline driving them both. Without that factor, Mydei was doomed to become sluggish.

At least that’s all Phainon could figure. 

Mydei shrugged, picking up his utensil again to tear off a bit more of his food, “It’s a trivial matter. One that will solve itself in time, that is why I said not to fret over such a thing.”

Phainon, however, with a mouth that was always too willing to run before actually planning ahead immediately piped up happily, “Can I help?”

“Can you help?” Mydei’s golden hued eyes landed on him again, looking almost egregiously at him. As if Phainon was going to sprout a second head at any moment from his neck.

“Well..” Phainon slowly began, his thoughts mainly wondering about all the methods he would normally try to use to go to sleep if he couldn’t. None of them sounded.. Right for Mydei. “Won’t you at least let me try? What do you have to lose, Mydei? Not sleep , it seems..”

“Hmm.” Another distressing sign was how Mydei hadn’t even bothered retorting against Phainon’s slight snark and jests. “Fine.”

Phainon could only knit his brows together at that, immediately swiftly standing, “Alright. Let’s go.” He had already paid, anyway. Now he had a prince to get to bed, it seemed. And that was much more pressing than letting Mydei piddle in his somber driven state.

“I have not finished my honeycakes.” Mydei pointed out, not meeting those searching ocean deep blue eyes as he instead focused ahead dully.

Phainon shook his head, eyes moving to the barely even touched food with a deep dramatic sigh, one he hoped got his point across. “And with your rabbit bites you’re taking currently, I fear you never will.”

Mydei gave the plate of golden honeycakes a sorrowful and mourning look, one that almost twisted Phainon’s heart. Almost. It was just golden honeycakes.. “ .. Alright.”

Phainon gave a pleased smile as he watched Mydei slowly shuffle his way out of his chair, once again following after Phainon wordlessly. As they walked, Phainon let out a small hum, an innocent one! He promises! 

“May we use your quarter’s bath?” Was his simple question that he said lightly, adding another small humming noise as he swiftly made his way towards the public overflowing bath, though he had no intentions of using it.

“Pardon? Mine? For what purpose?” Mydei slowly drawled out his words, clearly baffled as he followed after Phainon regardless of the evident confusion laced within his words.

“Less of a walk to put you into your bed, and has all your desired bathing products.” Phainon explained easily, fluidly, before giving a sharp exhale of laughter.“

Unless you want to use my bath and my thirteen in one soap I use? I don’t mind you borrowing some.” Phainon continued and teased, a smirk playing on his lips as he glanced at the man behind him who had his face pulled into a rough disapproving grimace over the idea.

Phainon knew very well this pretty crown prince would never use his soap - None of the other Chrysos Heirs would, actually. They all had been pretty vocal in their disgust over his choice of soap, but it was convenient! Even if Aglaea had robbed it from him on three separate occasions.. 

“.. My quarters will work fine.” Mydei grumbled out as he followed, not even needing to take the lead as Phainon knew the way anyways through the Marmoreal Palace and to Mydei’s own personal quarters. Not to say he had ever actually been in them, but he sure did stop by there to annoy the prince awake when he was in a really good mood and determined to make sure he infected Mydei with it. Even if Mydei wouldn’t admit he did.

The silence as they walked through those familiar halls didn’t last, however. Oddly broken by Mydei instead of Phainon, “We’re taking a bath together?”

“Indeed, well. You are, at least.” Phainon answered effortlessly, he had his plan after all. He could only hope it actually worked. He had no actual idea how to get Mydei soothed enough to find the embrace of sleep, honestly.

That doesn’t mean he wouldn’t try his best!

And he had some theories!

Well, one, really.

“I have tried that many times before.” Mydei sighed out heavily, though his tone lacked any true ire within it. Even though he said such a thing, Mydei made no signs of stopping his footfalls from trailing after Phainon. Something a more awake Mydei may have started to do when he found Phainon’s ideas foolish. 

“I have other intentions as well!” Phainon gleefully informed him as they came to Mydei’s quarter’s, stopping to move to the side of the door, waiting a few moments for Mydei to walk up and open it with his own keys. 

Mydei paused as he unlocked it, cocking his head to the side to cut a rather harsh glare towards Phainon, one seeped deep into accusations that need not be named. “.. Do not try anything weird, Deliverer. I will throw you from the rooftops.”

“Ha ha ha.” Phainon mocked slightly as he gave a lopsided smile, only slightly due to the fact he knew Mydei would, in fact, throw him from the rooftops. “I have no ‘odd’ intentions besides you finding sleep, Mydei.”

Mydei kept those fierce eyes on him for a moment before shaking his head as he opened his door, walking into the space he lived in before speaking, “Very well.”

Mydei’s personal living quarters within Marmoreal Palace were barren, not appearing lived in, nor loved.

But that only made Phainon feel slightly at home.

He understood. He understood more than more people could that this was not Mydei’s home deep within his heart, that he could never take time to decorate it or make it more comfortable. It was only a temporary living arrangement due to his own true home being gone.

“Alright well. Strip down.” Phainon said a bit too jokingly as he shut the door behind himself, immediately earning a rather withering glare from the crown prince. One that he rolled his eyes over and heaved a sigh at, dramatically waving his hands in surrender. 

“Put on a towel if you must. We’re bathing you, remember?” Phainon murmured with a shrug of his shoulders, only growing somewhat amused as he watched Mydei scowl at him just a bit more, “Here here, I’ll look away.” Phainon teased, turning away and placing his hands over his eyes, “And even cover my eyes for good measure!” 

He could only hear a light scoff from Mydei from behind him, “You are akin to an overgrown child, Deliverer.” 

Phainon fought back his snark and instead gave a light-hearted laugh in return. He certainly wasn’t willing to risk getting thrown out just yet.

Phainon now in the silence with his self imposed darkness could only focus on the shuffling movements of Mydei, the clacking and heavy fallings of metal as he undid latches and belts. Honestly, a part of him wanted to watch mainly to just marvel at how Mydei’s attire even worked, some of it was a slight mystery to Phainon when he scrutinized it.

It felt like ages before he heard another heavy falling of metal with some light jingling after it, followed swiftly by the sounds of water. There were already the sounds of running water - Sure. But this was different, obviously one of Mydei sinking himself into his own private bath. 

“I am ready.” Mydei spoke from behind, making Phainon drop his hand and blink harshly at the now somehow blinding light of Kephale peeking through Mydei’s room. “For what? I’m unsure.” Mydei muttered, moreso to himself than to the now humming Phainon as he approached and slowly went to the back of Mydei. 

Mydei was lounging, to put it simply. Both of his arms were somewhat out of the bath, behind him, resting on the floor instead to easily keep himself from sinking further into it. He was still adorning a towel over his waist in the bath - One that Phainon was thankful for, mainly for his sanity. His braid still had that golden cuff on it, Though, the lack of necklace on Mydei was strange enough to make Phainon instinctively look for it, quickly finding purchase on it resting gently on Mydei’s bed. 

The rest could not be said for the man’s normal attire that was strewn across the floor, no regard at all given for it outside his gauntlets that were placed neatly on the bed as well.

“For what?” Phainon repeated as he slowly kneeled behind Mydei’s head, a movement that Mydei did in fact slightly crane his head to watch, and Phainon wasn’t quite sure if it was out of curiosity or the deep instinct to protect himself for any and everyone. 

“Well, I’m going to wash your hair for you, of course.” Phainon spoke so matter of factly, as if it was the most obvious answer to be taking place here. There was no way he could wash anything but Mydei’s head, anyways, he would absolutely lose the last threads of his mental stability if he tried such a thing.

“.. I do not let people touch my hair often.” Mydei immediately countered, and Phainon was very aware of those blazing eyes burning into him, a look that he couldn’t tell was angry, or merely confused. 

“Often.” Phainon pointed out with a small smirk, leaning forward to more easily look at Mydei’s face, one that seemed to become screwed into deep consideration. “I’ll be gentle if you let me.” Phainon attempted to reassure him, though he never had any intentions of being rough to begin with. 

“.. Fine.” Mydei muttered, facing forward wholly, “Do not touch my braid.”

Phainon blinked at that, “I’ll do my best not to, Mydei.” 

“Can I borrow this?” Phainon moved that familiar goblet to Mydei’s front, directly in front of his face to save the man from looking for whatever Phainon meant, blinking at that crimson and gold cup. 

“For what?” Mydei’s response slowly came, making Phainon give a small laugh. 

“To put water on your hair, Mydei.” Phainon couldn’t fight the way his voice was slowly dropping in volume, becoming quiet with this now somewhat domestic setting. 

“Oh.” Mydei somehow seemed to be slowly matching Phainon in volume, “Alright.”

“When did you swipe that?” Mydei inquired swiftly after, clearly not recalling, “Are you becoming a worshipper of Zagreus in your spare time?”

Phainon hummed at the question, instantly moving to dip the item in question into the water as his eyes searched slightly for Mydei’s shampoo, “You’ve been really out of it, Mydei. I’ve been robbing you all blind week. ” Phainon spoke plainly, deadpanned, so much so that Mydei slowly threw a look over his shoulder with a rather baffled expression donned on his features.

Such an endearing look of unhidden feelings that Phainon could do nothing but cave immediately.

“ I’m joking . It was to the side of your bath, you’re so tired that you’re leaving your belongings scattered about.” 

Mydei scoffed at that, instead fixating his head forward again. Seemingly having no rebuttal for that, given the current state he left his clothes and armor in. The Mydei Phainon knew would have certainly folded them properly and fixed their positioning - Even if he was hurrying. 

“Going to use my hand to make sure I don’t get water in your eyes..” Was all Phainon said in warning before he dropped further to his hind legs, sitting on his butt before gently rounding a hand to Mydei’s forehead, brushing against the soft bangs there and moving them slightly as his fingers snuck under. 

Making sure to make a tight hold on Mydei’s forehead as a shield, only vaguely aware of the way Mydei’s skin was growing tacky. That was to be expected from the heat of the bath, and it wasn’t like Phainon hadn’t felt this man’s sweaty skin before. It didn’t really matter, but the way it was such an intimate thing made Phainon’s fingers tingle.

“Water won’t hurt me.” Mydei muttered out lowly, and Phainon was so very thankful to all the Titans that he was close enough to be able to see the growing hue of red in Mydei’s skin. One he would have assigned the blame to the bath, if not for the way it hadn’t begun until now. 

“Be quiet and enjoy your bath.” Phainon muttered loosely, only garnering a small huff of Mydei exhaling out of amusement. And thus, without any more delays Phainon slowly began drenching Mydei’s hair. It was a rather slow process, his goblet he carried didn’t seem to have much capacity in reality. 

But it would do.

This wasn’t a thing that needed to be rushed, Phainon had all the time in the world to attend to just this one soul that needed him. Once he was satisfied with the amount of water he had accrued atop Mydei’s head, he gently moved his hand he was using as a shield to tuck those bangs backwards as well, slowly wetting them - Careful and precise to make sure it didn’t horribly run down Mydei’s face.

Phainon took a few more moments, making sure everything, minus that braid, was thoroughly wet enough to actually start bathing Mydei. 

Mydei, in question, was rather quiet. Not offering a word nor mockery as Phainon moved behind him, repeatedly dunking that cup and moving to gently run the water down his head, letting it run down his back. 

Phainon set the golden cup down after a few more rinses, instead moving to grab Mydei’s shampoo and inspecting it for a moment. He had always been somewhat curious as to what soaps Mydei used - He always carried an undertone of sweetness before he got covered in sweat and muck. 

He could only bite back the horrible laugh that was threatening to rip through his lips over the picture of golden honeycakes on the front, along with the scent being the same. Because of course it was. Of course he used golden honeycake shampoo. Why would the crown prince of Castrum Kremnos use anything else?

“I can hear your silent judgement from here, Deliverer.” The monotone voice said below him, almost making Phainon jolt, “You cannot mock my choices when you use the most vile creation known to Amphoreus.”

Phainon let out a laugh, a genuine one as he opened the bottle, almost unsure of how much to use. Mydei certainly had.. More hair than him, by far. “It’s a cute choice.” Phainon said without a hint of malice or without meaning it as a slight. 

Mydei only let out a quiet ‘harumph’ from his sitting position as he shook his head slightly. 

Phainon poured some of the shampoo on his hands, taking just a moment to sniff it out of sheer curiosity. It sure was the smell Mydei always carried, even if it wasn’t exactly like golden honeycakes. Maybe that's why he had never picked up on it. 

Phainon moved to coat his hands with the gooey liquid before taking a deep breath, now suddenly nervous over the fact Mydei was allowing him to have this gentle and tender moment with him. 

Mydei probably didn’t understand how deeply Phainon would treasure the memory, anyway.

Phainon gently carded his fingers into light blonde locks of hair, moving his fingers against Mydei’s scalp in a massaging fashion - Firmly, but never enough to be uncomfortable. Phainon had never done this before or had it done to him, he could only try to make sure it was soothing as he gently rubbed in the shampoo. 

He moved slowly, every movement with purpose as he tried to massage the scalp of Mydei, rubbing small circles into his head. He tried not to think about how soft the hair there was, how long he had wondered about the fluffy hairs that pooled into a mane. He tried even harder, to ignore the way Mydei seemed to be leaning into his hands as he went.

Methodical in his approach, Phainon works the shampoo in slowly, kneading it into every ounce of Mydei’s head. Taking his time with every tender touch, clinically rubbing his scalp, hoping that it was a soothing touch. And if the way Mydei seemed to be pressing his head into Phainon’s hands was any attempt of telling him good job silently, he would take it.

Phainon dared not speak as he removed his right hand to return to scooping water, finding Mydei’s hair sudsy enough for a rinse. The crown prince need not worry, Phainon had no intention of quickly rinsing out the conditioner in a few moments if he just wanted to bask into the head massage. 

Phainon makes sure to keep his steady rubbing movements with his left hand, not wanting to deprive Mydei of the sensation so abruptly as he slowly works the soap into and out of his hair with each hand. It doesn't take long before he has to remove his other hand, cleaning the shampoo away. Making sure all the residue of it is wiped clean - Else Mydei may have his head when he snaps out of whatever trance he’s in.

Mydei still remains in silence, and Phainon follows suit. It was too much of a vulnerable peaceful moment. One that Phainon dared not ruin with his snark or coy comments, lest he risk angering the lion before him. 

He could only breathe in the silence as he leaned a bit away, grabbing the bottle of conditioner - He didn’t inspect this one. He didn’t want to give Mydei long enough to wake himself up again, instead immediately moving to spill it into his hands and get to work.

He was slower now, more precise - More endeared by Mydei’s instant leaning into his hands as he worked. Phainon knew very damned well he may never get Mydei leaning into him like this again, he had to savor it. And that he did.

Every movement he took was slow, languid, feeling every inch of Mydei’s scalp beneath his calloused fingers. Mapping it out, as if there was anything to take note of beneath the mess of vibrant hair. 

Phainon almost jumped at the low hum from Mydei, the way he could feel it beneath his finger tips as he glided them through the strands of hair. Making sure they were all coated nicely as he continued his soothing motions.

“You’re quite good at this.” Mydei’s compliment came out rather quietly, one that Phainon was unsure was due to not wanting to ruin the peace, or simply because of how tired he was truly becoming. 

“You’re supposed to be falling asleep, not talking.” Phainon mused out with a small laugh, a quiet breathy thing it was. “But thank you.”

Mydei didn’t respond to that, instead falling back into his silence as Phainon continued his task at hand. Mydei’s hair was beyond soft, so very much so that Phainon found himself almost giving up his routine of thirteen in one in favor of copying Mydei. 

Almost.

Phainon continued his methodical and slow movements, rubbing those soothing circles into the skin beneath the hair, gently combing through the hair with his hands. Feeling the way it was akin to silk between his fingers.

Phainon almost felt a sense of mourning as he slowly copied his earlier actions to rinse his hair out thoroughly. Becoming rather practiced in this scooping water and spilling it over Mydei, even as he allowed himself to copy his shielding from before. Moving his other hand to Mydei’s forehand gently after rinsing the conditioner from those fingers.

“The shampoo would have hurt my eyes more.” Mydei pointed out as that barrier returned to his forehead, clearly amused by Phainon’s attempts.

“You seemed more asleep during that. Thought your eyes would be closed.” Phainon confessed with a shrug of his shoulders as he gently ran that golden goblet across and down Mydei’s hair slowly, “Your snark now tells me you’re more awake.”

Mydei gave a laugh at that, low and melody inducing to Phainon’s ears. “You would be right.”

Phainon didn’t have a retort for that, instead focusing wholly on his work, moving his hand from Mydei’s face to run his fingers through his hair. Looking for any soap he may have missed before seeming to have found none. 

Phainon gently combed his fingers through those strands a few more times, rather self indulgently. He had no reason not to. No reason to rush Mydei into standing up and being done at this moment. No reason not to take in the sight of the beautiful prince sitting before him.

Mydei, however, seemed to have other thoughts of his fingers brushing through his hair.

“I own an actual comb, you know?” He said slowly with a sigh, “Unlike you, I presume.”

Phainon immediately gave a huff of exasperation, “I own a comb too!” 

“Really? With your bathing regiment I found doubt in my heart.” Mydei’s voice was level, but laced with snark as he slowly stood up, and Phainon was so very thankful for that low hanging towel on Mydei’s waist as Phainon was now blinking at it. “I’m proud of you for at least owning a comb, Deliverer.”

Phainon debated his words before quickly standing as well, “You have to let me dry your hair, you’re dripping wet.” Mydei froze at that, tilting his head curiously. “I can dry it myself.”

“And you could have washed it yourself as well.” Phainon retorted easily, giving a dramatic sigh as he shook his head over Mydei standing in the bath still, “I’m trying to get you to sleep, Mydei. Work with me here.”

Mydei stood there seemingly weighing those words as Phainon quickly moved away, vaguely aware of those liquid gold eyes burning into his every move as he swiftly obtained a towel. And then a second towel. One for Mydei’s body, the other for Phainon to dry his hair.

Phainon said nothing as he offered one to Mydei, which the man accepted just as wordlessly before taking the few steps to leave the bath. 

“Sit.” Phainon sternly gave the order, one that usually would earn a hiss and snarl from Mydei, and almost did judging by the narrowed glare he received. Yet Mydei did in fact move to the chair Phainon pointed to, not before without warning dropping his wet towel from his waist to replace it with his dry one. 

An action Phainon immediately felt the heat over before giving a deep groan. He had just seen the crown prince of Castrum Kremnos’s bare ass cheeks and no one would even believe him.

Mydei didn’t seem bothered, simply sitting down and moving judging piercing amber eyes to Phainon, who took that as his sign to follow after the man. Trying his best not to think about the perfect ass Mydei had on him, something he surely would not be forgetting when he tried to sleep later tonight..

Phainon was even less sure how to dry someone’s hair, honestly. He fought back the urge to just drape the entire thing over Mydei’s head, instead gently moving to continue those massaging methods he had before. Sometimes taking his hair and attempting to coax the water clinging to it and into the towel.

Phainon really hadn’t thought this through, he realized, after a few minutes of gently trying to dry Mydei’s hair.

He had never considered how long Mydei’s hair would take to dry over his own..

Even Mydei seemed tired of it as he pushed out a sigh, “My comb is on my bedside table.”

Phainon moved to look at that, taking that as Mydei’s ‘enough’ warning as he went to gain the comb. Pausing as he gently took it. It looked expensive, not out of the ordinary for a prince, sure. But deliberate. The gold within it and the stones covering the rims of it, varying colors and meanings lost on a person like Phainon, he couldn’t help but turn it between his hands with the towel.

Phainon moved back to Mydei, he wouldn’t voice it, but something in his head understood this was something dear to Mydei probably. Considering his lack of other things in his room, such a flashy comb stood out heavily.

Phainon now worked rather clumsily, trying to comb Mydei’s locks while also drying them. He had training in sword fighting and some in dance and other things - But not hair styling. Which was harder than he had ever assumed. 

Mydei didn’t voice any dissatisfaction however, seemingly fine with whatever as long as Phainon was careful enough to avoid that braid in his hair. 

Since that was off limits, of course Phainon easily avoided even brushing by it.

It didn’t take long before Mydei pulled away slightly, leaning forward. “I’m moving to my bed.” Was all he said before standing, leaving a baffled Phainon watch as the fellow heir moved to his bed and unceremoniously flopped into it, immediately dragging the cover atop it over himself lazily.

Well. The goal was to put him to sleep, so this was probably fine. 

Phainon stood there for a moment, before shuffling awkwardly as he stared at Mydei’s back. This was probably his sign to go, he noted to himself. Moving to put the comb back where it belonged, and briskly moving to the exit.

“.. Don’t go.” Was the quiet murmur behind him, making Phainon effortlessly freeze in his steps. Turning slightly to look at Mydei, who had now turned to his other side. Facing Phainon with those vibrant amber hued eyes. He looked beyond exhausted now, even worse with his damp hair feathered about due to Phainon’s piss poor brushing and drying attempts.

“Oh, You want me to stay?” Phainon questioned, feeling his heart fluttering slightly as he instead slowly moved back into the room curiously. 

“You have your teleslate to entertain you, don’t you?” Mydei grumbled out, closing his eyes already as Phainon found himself sitting now. “Just until I fall asleep..”

Phainon slowly nodded in understanding, even though Mydei couldn’t see that. “Ah… Alright. Sure.” 

“.. Thank you.” Mydei’s lips had barely moved to say those words, making Phainon fight back a soft chuckle as he knew Mydei was already drifting into his slumber.

“Of course, Mydei.”

Phainon sat there in the lone chair of Mydei’s quarters, attempting his best to not just be staring down Mydei as the crown prince tried to fall asleep. It felt like ages before Phainon felt as though Mydei had finally done just that, a look of natural relaxation resting heavily on his features. 

Phainon had only rarely seen Mydei sleep, and even then he was always appearing on edge. Guarded. As if not even sleep was a peaceful escape for the immortal man. Phainon found himself staring fondly at him just a few steps away, the way the lion man seemed for once completely at ease.

Phainon was more thankful than ever to the Titans for gracing him with this moment of vulnerability offered by Mydei. 

Phainon didn’t dare use his teleslate, no. He understood very well what Mydei had meant by asking him to stay. Phainon had accepted this silent vigil of watching over Mydei easily. He didn’t mind, not when it came to Mydei. 

Phainon would stay and protect Mydei for as long as he desired, if it meant the one source of stability in Phainon’s turbulent life got some rest he sorely deserved within this life.

Phainon found a small smile on his lips as he watched the steadiness within Mydei’s breaths, the way his hair was still damp, feathering about every which way even though Phainon had attempted his best at brushing it. It still seemed unruly, a mane that was never able to be tamed. 

The realization made Phainon breath out a silent laugh.

“You’re going to kill me when you see how your wet hair dried, Mydei..” He noted in a voice that was barely even reaching a whisper. 

And Phainon could only think that maybe Mydei hadn’t even needed a soothing bath, maybe he just needed the ability and comfort to feel safe knowing someone was there for him.

Just for a little while.
